lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: When did you take this?
: When Maya and I were waiting for you on the roof.
: We weren't really sure how to pass the time, so I decided to take some pictures while Maya was all like grrrr I'm Maya.
: It's really weird, though! They seemed normal when I looked at them on the roof. But after we reset, the sky was gone in all of them.
: Do you think it means anything?
: I have no idea. Have you shown it to Maya?
: Yeah, but she doesn't have any idea either.
: It's the big black thing that weirds me out the most. Not a sex joke.
: It's pretty much in the same exact spot where the moon was, but...idk. Looking at it makes me feel weird.
: Kinda like it's watching us or something.
: It certainly does have a...threatening aura to it?
: Right???
: The slumber party thing didn't really work, but maybe we can try taking more pictures next time we're up there?
: Oooh, video too. We should try all sorts of stuff since doing the same thing over and over obviously hasn't worked for you guys.
: Well, I'm glad that you seem to be enjoying this.
: I'm making the most of it. You should too.
: It's scary, yeah. But we have each other. And we should do everything we can to keep each other comfortable while we're up there.
: Everything except having sex, that is. Since Maya doesn't want to watch us for some reason.
: I'm sure you know what that reason is, Ayane.
: Yeah, I'm sure Maya does as well. And yet...
: Okay...well, if we're not going to talk about the picture anymore, I should probably go.
: Same. I'm actually in the bath with Sana right now.
: Why didn't you send me that instead?
: Because Sana's tiny boobies aren't going to save the world.
: You don't know that.
: Good point. Let's try and get her up there for the next reset.
: I'll talk to you later, [ayanemaster]. I love you :)
: I love you too.
